item.description: AI now sits on both sides of the security fight, and the vocabulary has changed with it. item.title: Architect Labs Unveils Frostbite, an Interaction Net CPU Designed by AI
item.description: Architect Labs introduced Frostbite, an AI-designed CPU that runs interaction nets in hardware. Agents took it from theory to 7 nm GDS, and pre-silicon tests show 4.59x performance per watt over an in-order core. The post Architect Labs Unveils Frostbite, an Interaction Net CPU Designed by AI appeared first on MarkTechPost .

item.title: Meta TLX Brings Warp-Group GPU Control to Triton on Hopper, Blackwell, AMD
item.description: Meta has detailed TLX, its Triton Low-Level Extensions that add warp-group, barrier, TMA and cluster control to Python Triton kernels. It runs Meta's ads and LLM workloads on Hopper, Blackwell and AMD MI350 GPUs. The post Meta TLX Brings Warp-Group GPU Control to Triton on Hopper, Blackwell, AMD appeared first on MarkTechPost .

If verified, it would mark yet another seismic achievement for AI in mathematics and add to the upheaval […]

item.title: Meta ads is now available in AWS Quick
item.description: AWS Quick now has a Meta ads AI connector. Meta advertisers can use natural language in Quick to create, manage, and analyze campaigns while staying connected to the Meta ad management network, and combine Meta ad data with first- and third-party sources to build dashboards, documents, slide decks, and automated workflows.

item.title: A Team of Researchers from Columbia and CertiK Introduce TensorLean for Formal Verification of GPU Kernels
item.description: TensorLean, from Columbia University and CertiK, formally verifies production GPU kernels at the PTX level using Lean. It checked 149 kernel instances, proved 83 correct, and found 38 bugs in FlashAttention, DeepGEMM and more. The post A Team of Researchers from Columbia and CertiK Introduce TensorLean for Formal Verification of GPU Kernels appeared first on MarkTechPost .

item.title: New in AWS Quick: More capable flows, an updated web experience, and agents that work together
item.description: AWS Quick is the AI workspace built only for work. Today we're releasing updates that help your team get more done: build and run business-process flows in chat, triage your day in the updated web app, get more complete answers from multiple agents at once, and connect new data sources like Meta ads and Amplitude.

item.title: Cut self-hosted LLM cost and latency with the distributed KV caching agent skill
item.description: Self-hosting LLMs on GPUs means paying to recompute the same context on every turn. Distributed KV caching with Amazon ElastiCache can cut inference cost by up to 40% and time to first token by up to 80%. This post walks through the distributed KV caching skill in the Agent Toolkit for AWS, which evaluates and sets up the cache from your coding agent.

item.title: Introducing Amazon SageMaker HyperPod Global Inference Gateway: One endpoint across Regions and clusters
item.description: Amazon SageMaker HyperPod introduces the Global Inference Gateway, one managed endpoint that routes inference requests across your HyperPod clusters in one Region or across Regions. It picks the best cluster, fails over automatically, and authenticates every request with SigV4 and IAM over AWS PrivateLink.

item.title: How Standard Bank Group automates AI risk assessment for generative AI
item.description: Standard Bank Group automated the evidence behind its generative AI approval gates. Working with AWS Professional Services, the bank built an assessment in its own AWS account that scores each use case against international AI standards and its own policies using LLM-as-a-judge on Amazon Bedrock, giving risk committees consistent, traceable evidence.

item.title: Announcing Amazon Textract Insights: Verifiable generative AI for documents
item.description: Announcing the general availability of Amazon Textract Insights, a new generative AI feature of Amazon Textract. Describe the fields you need in natural language, submit a document or a mixed packet, and receive structured results with a confidence score and page-level grounding for each value, with no model training required.

item.title: New approach enables physically consistent AI models of chaotic systems
item.description: Enforcing physics-based constraints prevents AI models from generating unreliable predictions for complex nonlinear systems in weather, climate, and turbulent flows.

item.title: Introducing enhanced infrastructure observability in Amazon SageMaker HyperPod
item.description: Amazon SageMaker HyperPod now offers enhanced observability to help you diagnose GPU training issues faster. It brings together diagnostic and profiling capabilities for training workloads on both Amazon EKS and Slurm orchestrators, pinpointing issues across GPU, network, and host layers.
